adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `Discourse.Group.findMembers()` (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js) returns `Discourse.ajax(...).then(...)` with no `.catch`/rejection handling. New callers in routes (`admin_group_route.js` and `group-members.js.es6`) invoke `model.findMembers();` without returning/handling the promise, and pagination actions (`next`/`previous` in admin-group.js.es6) return the promise but also do not attach any error handling. From the diff alone, a failed request (500/404/network) would not produce any explicit user-visible error behavior; at best it would surface via whatever global RSVP/ajax handling exists (not shown in this diff). This is a concrete robustness/UX gap introduced/exposed by the new async loading flow, but not a strictly verifiable functional break without knowing the app’s global error handlers.
